Override: no contradicted class-10 assurance; Karnataka pass-through assurance (SEVERE-test candidate) untested pending enactment. Access: transcripts read as text renders on financialfilings.com (NSE/BSE/CDN PDFs blocked by proxy/robots); quotes are verbatim as rendered, auto-transcription errors possible. Gaps: Q3 FY25 and pre-Aug-2023 transcripts have no page markers; FY26 Annual Report not readable; FY26 pellet tonnes not in any filed document opened; no filings found for Deposit 4/13, Deposit 5 conveyor, tender awards, Maharatna, overseas acquisition.
